caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular picture frame with a decorative border. The frame is positioned horizontally, occupying the central portion of the beige or off-white background. The outer and inner edges of the frame feature a repeating pattern of small yellow and red flower motifs set against a dark, almost black background. Between these floral borders is a scalloped, wavy design in alternating red, green, and yellow colors. At each of the four corners, there is a stylized leaf or petal motif in shades of pink and orange, outlined in yellow. The overall color palette of the frame includes dark brown or black, yellow, red, green, pink, and orange. The frame itself is empty, showing only the plain interior, and the drawing is rendered in a flat, two-dimensional style.
title: Pa. German Picture Frame
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
